title: Rename a View
description: Learn how to rename a view using sp_rename and SQL Server Management Studio.

data.text: Before renaming a view, be aware that all objects that depend on the view may fail. These include stored procedures, user-defined functions, triggers, queries, other views, and client applications.

data.title: Rename a view using sp_rename
data.content: Renames a view from product_catalog to product_list.

data.text: SQL Server will warn that changing any part of an object name could break scripts and stored procedures.
In SQL Server Management Studio, expand Databases > your database > Views, right-click the view you want to rename, and select Rename. Then type the new name and press Enter.

data.title: Rename View Key Points
points: Use sp_rename to rename a view via T-SQL.
Always specify the schema-qualified view name in sp_rename.
Renaming a view can break dependent objects — update references accordingly.
You can also rename views through SSMS by right-clicking and selecting Rename.
